question: Calculate the average rating for each product by category, excluding categories with an average rating lower than 3.

pred_sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.name, c.category_name, AVG(r.rating) AS avg_rating FROM products p JOIN reviews r ON p.product_id = r.product_id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.average_rating >= 3 GROUP BY p.product_id, c.category_name;
